verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single docs line saying Elasticsearch can combine search with structured filters and aggregations in one engine. Aggregations are the mechanism behind facet counts, but the pack never describes faceted navigation itself. missing for 10: explicit documentation of faceted navigation with live per-bucket counts, range/category/attribute facet examples, confirmation that facets and results come back from a single query, independent or hands-on corroboration.
